description: Container lock 2026-08-16 12:30:33 UTC. Ghost said the warm tank level watchdog fired despite the level being OK, so the sensor must not have been reading.

messages.text: Ghost, can you figure out what triggered the interlock supervisor? Was there a pressure that wasn't low enough, or something else?

ground_truth: warm_tank_level_watchdog (min 14.0, max 46.0, applies while warm/hot loop pumps are enabled). Warm tank level was valid and fell to 13.99 at the edge with both loop pumps on: a real low-level trip, not a missing sensor. warm_tank_level_recovery ran; lock stayed set.

must_not.name: does not blame a non-reading sensor
